labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Pwndrop is a self-deployable file hosting service for sending out red teaming payloads or securely sharing your private files over HTTP and WebDAV.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Pwndrop

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24 AS buildstage

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# build variables
ARG PWNDROP_RELEASE

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    build-base \
    go

RUN \
echo "**** fetch source code ****" && \
  if [ -z ${PWNDROP_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    PWNDROP_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/kgretzky/pwndrop/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/pwndrop && \
  curl -o \
  /tmp/pwndrop-src.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/kgretzky/pwndrop/archive/${PWNDROP_RELEASE}.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
  /tmp/pwndrop-src.tar.gz -C \
    /tmp/pwndrop --strip-components=1 && \
  echo "**** compile pwndrop  ****" && \
  cd /tmp/pwndrop && \
  go build -ldflags="-s -w" \
    -o /app/pwndrop/pwndrop \
    -mod=vendor \
    main.go && \
  cp -r ./www /app/pwndrop/admin

############## runtime stage ##############
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PWNDROP_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

# add pwndrop
COPY --from=buildstage /app/pwndrop/ /app/pwndrop/

RUN \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8080 4443

units.name: init-pwndrop-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /config/data

if [[ ! -f "/config/data/pwndrop.db" ]]; then
    SECRET_PATH=${SECRET_PATH:-/pwndrop}
    echo "New install detected, starting pwndrop with secret path ${SECRET_PATH}"
    echo -e "\n[setup]\nsecret_path = \"${SECRET_PATH}\"" >> /defaults/pwndrop.ini
fi

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /config \
    /defaults

units.name: svc-pwndrop
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

exec \
    s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8080" \
        s6-setuidgid abc \
            /app/pwndrop/pwndrop \
                -debug \
                -no-autocert \
                -no-dns \
                -config /defaults/pwndrop.ini
